title: The Ghost ID in the Sequence
description: A database contains a continuous sequence of employee identification numbers ranging from 0 to n, but exactly one identification number is missing from the system logs. Write a function to find the missing ID.
constraints: All the numbers of nums are unique.
input_format: An array of integers nums containing distinct numbers from 0 to n.
output_format: An integer representing the missing number.

examples.explanation: n = 3 since there are 3 numbers, so all numbers are in the range [0, 3]. 2 is the missing number.
n = 2, so the range is [0, 2]. 2 is missing.
